parsed.why: No trans criminalisation or documented targeting, but thin data: no recognition, no gender-identity protection ground, only general LGBTQ stigma. Structurally mild, unevidenced either way, so mid-range rather than reduced risk.

Same-sex conduct criminalised, absolute monarchy rated not free, LGBT groups refused registration, official and religious hostility, killings documented, no protections. Outing risks criminal exposure with no recourse; Pride events only soften the floor.

Never criminalised, but documented transfemicide pattern, birth-sex jail placement with head-shaving, police arresting Pride-goers, local cross-dressing bans and routine service refusals outweigh patchwork local ordinances and safe-spaces fines.

Decriminalised with sectoral protections and no violence record, but state rejects every marker change, excludes same-sex partners from domestic-violence law, omits orientation from constitutional grounds, and foreign markers aren't honoured at the frontier.

Strong protections, functioning courts granting relief, hate-crime doubling and non-surgical recognition — offset by documented humiliating airport gender screening, record-high 2025 violence with organised ambushes, and segregation-based custody practice.
